description: A locked `<db>` cell whose tape type grants `append` but not `replace` is refused at its declaration (E-DB-CELL-EDIT-GRANT): a locked `<db>` cell is read-only on the client, so the edit grant could never be used.
rationale: RULED S472 (`<db>` body + client reads) item 5: "locked cells are read-only on the client" — read categorically (PA reading of the S472 ruling, S473).
